The '''Ban-Satir system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]], located within the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ban-Satir II]].
